fields.name: token
fields.label: Integration token
fields.hint: Make an internal connection in Notion (notion.so/profile/integrations, New connection, with an API token) and copy its token here. A personal access token works too. It is kept in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password.

fields.name: database
fields.label: Database
fields.hint: The database's link (its ... menu, Copy link) or its id; a data source's id works too. Share the database with your connection first: its ... menu, Connections.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Shown at the top. Left empty: the database's own name.

fields.name: property1
fields.label: First property to show
fields.hint: A property of the database by its name, shown under each row's title: a status or select as a colored tag, a date in red once it is past, a person, a number, text.

fields.name: property2
fields.label: Second property to show
fields.hint: Another property shown beside the first. Leave it empty for one.

fields.name: checkbox
fields.label: Checkbox
fields.hint: A checkbox property: each row gets a box, and a tap ticks it in Notion. The connection needs to be allowed to update content.

fields.name: hideChecked
fields.label: Hide ticked rows
fields.hint: Leave out the rows whose checkbox is ticked (they go at the next refresh).

fields.name: hideStatus
fields.label: Hide rows with status
fields.hint: Leave out the rows whose status is one of these, by name, with commas between: an option (Done, Archived) or a whole group (Complete). Empty shows every row.

fields.name: sortBy
fields.label: Sort by
fields.hint: A property's name, or created or edited for when a row was made or last changed. Left empty: by the date shown, soonest first, else the newest rows first.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

notionDatabase.name: Notion database
notionDatabase.description: A Notion database's rows: each title with up to two properties, done rows left out, sorted. Tap a row's box to tick its checkbox in Notion.
